messages:
Ava (Marketing): Quick thread — SparkWave launch newsletter needs final segmentation + send cadence. I uploaded a draft and audience filters here: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/sparkwave-launch. Can people skim and say if the split looks good?

Rohit (Growth): Looking. My initial thought — split by recent activity + trial status: 40% recent active trials, 30% inactive trials, 20% product users (no trial), 10% external partners. Prefer 3 staggered sends (NA / EMEA / APAC) over 36–48h to smooth deliverability.

Samira (Content): Nice. Adding subject line options, short A/B pairs: 
```
Option A: Meet Redwood Inference — faster, cheaper LLM inference
Option B: See how your apps get faster LLM responses (SparkWave launch)
Option C: [Early access] Lower latency LLMs for production
```
Keep copy tight and call out cost/latency benefits. I can trim hero and add 2 micro-CTAs (docs + demo signup).

Michael (Ops): FYI ESP throttle limit is 150k/hr on our staging send. If we geo-stagger we should be fine. Also confirm suppression list includes: unsubscribes, trial opt-outs, and customers_in_dedicated. I’ll run a dry-run against a 1k seed.

Ava (Marketing): Good call. Can we set burst caps and failure fallback? If ESP rejects, we should pause and route to follow-up reminder sequence.

Michael (Ops): Yep — plan: burst cap = 120k/hr, fallback: pause + alert to #release-war-room, then retry after 2h with 25% velocity. I’ll add monitor hooks.

Rohit (Growth): Segment refinements: add engagement flag (opened any Redwood newsletter in last 90 days) — want higher send weight to engaged. Also exclude any leads in current enterprise cohort.

Samira (Content): Subject lines + preheader tests: run 2x2 matrix (Option A vs B) x (short preheader vs benefit preheader). Preheaders I’ll draft.

Ava (Marketing): Timeline: final copy by EOD tomorrow, list prep by Michael by EOD today, ESP test tomorrow morning, send window starts Thursday 10:00 PST for NA. Does that work?

Michael (Ops): I’ll push list and run test at 09:30 PST tomorrow.

Rohit (Growth): I’ll wire up the A/B test in the campaign tool and set conversion event = demo signups within 7 days. Also adding UTMs: ?utm_campaign=sparkwave_launch&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter.

campaign-bot: Draft saved to campaign workspace: "sparkwave-launch-newsletter". Reminder scheduled: review meeting tomorrow 10:00 AM PT.

Samira (Content): Quick copy note: highlight one benchmark stat (median latency drop) in the first fold — we have permission to use Redwood internal benchmark numbers? @Ava to confirm.

Ava (Marketing): Yes, we can use the benchmark line — keep it high level. I’ll post the exact approved stat in the doc.

Rohit (Growth): Action items: 
- Samira: finalize subjects + preheaders (EOD tomorrow)
- Michael: run seed test + export suppression list (today EOD)
- Ava: approve benchmark wording + final hero (tomorrow morning)
- Rohit: configure A/B test + UTMs (tomorrow morning)

Samira (Content): On it :white_check_mark:

Michael (Ops): Will post seed test results here when done.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks team — let’s keep this lean. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. :rocket:
